newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel takes stake in Chilean utility.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel takes stake in Chilean utility.

text.p: Belgian utility group Tractebel SA said on Friday that a consortium headed by its subsidiary Powerfin SA acquired a 37.5 percent stake in Chilean power firm Colbun Machicura SA for $340.9 million.

It said in a statement that the consortium, Inversiones Colbun, also has an option to buy a further 12.5 percent in Colbun Machicura, Chile's third-largest power company, but already holds the voting rights for those shares.
"(This) means (the consortium) effectively controls the company," Tractebel said.

Powerfin has a direct stake of 7.5 percent in Inversiones Colbu. The other partners are Minera Valparaiso SA, part of leading Chilean industrial group Matte with a stake of 41.5 percent and Inversora Electrica Andina with 51 percent, in which Powerfin holds 62.5 percent.
Colbun Machicura currently has an installed generating capacity of 585 MW spread over three hydroelectric power stations.
Two other production units are under construction and are due to come on stream in 1998.
